author: Engineezy
description:
Straight Line Redemption
•••
I want to redeem myself for the squiggly line drawing mechanism from my last video.  I made a poor motor choice and used a servo that kind of jitters as it moves.  This was one of the reasons the lines had a ripple in them, but what was worse were the absolute trash I used for bearings.  They were supposed to be ABEC 3 rated, but they weren’t even close.  I decided to try using them anyway.  It was a bad idea, and after swapping them with some higher quality bearings, and after using a stepper motor instead of that garbage servo, now we have some much straighter lines.
